trainingHypothesis: Improve performer/domain robustness of the existing V7 causal temporal representation using only fresh reference-blind training-side augmentations and invariance regularization on the already-authorized clean P1/P2 development population; keep the frozen V8 decoder fixed during model selection.

allowedPerturbations: bounded time-local masking that does not alter target labels
